hazards.name: Poor Lane Delineation
hazards.description: Faded or absent lane markings can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning.

hazards.name: Complete Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: Water-filled barriers and construction pipes completely block the pedestrian walkway, forcing people into the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground across the entire walkway

hazards.name: Trip Hazards
hazards.description: Loose construction materials and metal plates on the ground create significant tripping risks for anyone attempting to navigate the area.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, on the ground in front of the barriers

hazards.name: Large vehicle visual obstruction
hazards.description: A large delivery truck parked at the curb completely blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street, parked at the curb

hazards.name: Bridge Abutment Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: The massive stone bridge supports block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left and center-right of the image.

hazards.name: Lack of Road Markings
hazards.description: The absence of lane lines and crosswalks creates an unpredictable environment for both drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Driveway Conflict
hazards.description: A wide vehicle access ramp crosses the sidewalk without any markings or signage to alert drivers to pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, where the ramp intersects the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: Orange plastic barriers on the left side block the sidewalk and force any pedestrian activity closer to moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and mid-ground along the building frontage

hazards.name: Lack of Lane Markings
hazards.description: The absence of painted lane lines on a wide roadway can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and higher speeds.

hazards.name: Degraded Roadway Pavement
hazards.description: The road surface is heavily cracked, pitted, and patched, which can create tripping hazards for pedestrians crossing or cause unpredictable vehicle movements.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Crossing
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance, increasing exposure to vehicle traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway area leading to the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Overpass
hazards.description: The bridge structure and resulting deep shadows can obscure pedestrians from drivers' view, particularly when moving between light and dark areas.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and upper portion of the frame where the bridge spans the road

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: Long stretches of fencing and windowless building walls reduce natural surveillance and create a hostile pedestrian environment.

hazards.name: Construction barriers
hazards.description: Orange plastic barriers on the left sidewalk narrow the pedestrian path and may force people closer to the roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway on the near side of the street, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom foreground and left side of the image

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: The large stone bridge abutment and pillars block the view of oncoming traffic for anyone attempting to cross near the bridge.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image under the rail bridge

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Provide a clearly marked and protected temporary walkway around the construction site to maintain pedestrian continuity and safety.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to improve sightlines between motorists and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Clear Pedestrian Detour Signage
interventions.description: Provide clear signage indicating the safe path for pedestrians around the temporary work zone or barriers.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Protection
interventions.description: If the barriers are intended to prevent vehicle encroachment, replace temporary plastic barriers with permanent bollards or planters to improve aesthetics and safety.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing Evaluation
interventions.description: Given the high-volume transit entrance, evaluate the need for a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage and lighting.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median refuge island at the intersection to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing zone.

interventions.title: High-visibility mid-block crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and pedestrian crossing signage to facilitate safe transit access.

interventions.title: Street trees and furniture zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer of street trees or planters to provide physical and psychological separation between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility crosswalk to provide a legal and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a line of street trees to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway, while also narrowing the perceived street width.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and the clear walking path to increase separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Improved Work Zone Pedestrian Access
interventions.description: Ensure construction barriers do not unnecessarily narrow the walkway and provide clear, ADA-compliant paths during construction phases.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes are high, install a marked mid-block crosswalk with appropriate signage and lighting.

interventions.title: Protected Temporary Walkway
interventions.description: Establish a temporary, ADA-compliant pedestrian path using barriers to separate people from traffic while the sidewalk is obstructed.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with curb extensions to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Use paint or physical buffers to narrow travel lanes, which naturally reduces vehicle speeds and provides space for a bike lane or wider buffer.

interventions.title: Restore Walkway Width
interventions.description: Remove temporary plastic barriers once work is complete to restore the full width of the pedestrian plaza.

interventions.title: Roadway Re-striping
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility lane markings to organize traffic flow and improve safety for pedestrians at the curb edge.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for a protected bike lane or a wider median.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Provide a protected walkway in the parking lane or roadway during construction to maintain ADA-compliant sidewalk width.

interventions.title: Construction Site Management
interventions.description: Relocate construction materials to a designated storage area that does not encroach on the public right-of-way.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Add a marked crosswalk with appropriate signage and potentially a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safer crossing point on this long block.

interventions.title: Under-bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale lighting under the bridge to improve visibility and security.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Apply continental or ladder-style pavement markings across the driveway to clearly delineate the pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with continental markings and appropriate signage to provide a designated, visible crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and repave the degraded asphalt to improve safety and predictability for all road users.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Add high-intensity, pedestrian-scale lighting under the overpass to eliminate dark spots and improve safety.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked midblock crossing to provide a designated and safer path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street trees and furniture
interventions.description: Add street trees and pedestrian-scale lighting to provide a buffer from traffic and improve the walking environment.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on the near side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Mid-block Signalized Crossing
interventions.description: Install a HAWK signal or full traffic signal with marked crosswalks to provide a protected crossing point in this long block.
